The '''Kadavo slave processing facility''' was built on the planet [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]] by the [[Zygerrian Slavers Guild]]. It hovered in one of the larger [[Wikipedia:caldera|calderas]] of a super volcano on the planet.

==Description==
[[File:TogrutaSlaves-SoR.png|thumb|left|250px|Togruta slaves gathered in the Hub]]
The hub was a tall cylindrical building where a large number of slave were kept while awaiting sale. It was kept aloft above a pool of lava by several powerful [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]]. It was also anchored in place by four cables attached to the sides of the caldera.

==History==
{{Quote|General Kenobi. You are the first Jedi I have entertained at our educational center.|Keeper Agruss|<ref name="Slaves">{{TCW|Slaves of the Republic}}</ref>}}
The Hub was commanded by an overweight [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] named [[Agruss]]. Zygerrian [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] and [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s, given to the Zygerrians by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], provided security.

A [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] colony that was abducted from the [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]] system was kept at the Hub for a time in preparation to be auctioned off.<ref name="Slaves">{{TCW|Slaves of the Republic}}</ref> After an unsuccessful rescue attempt, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] were also sent to the processing hub in chains.<ref name="TCW 4">[[The Clone Wars 4|''The Clone Wars'' 4]]</ref>

Later, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] led a large group of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces to rescue Obi-Wan and the prisoners.<ref name="Escape" /> The Jedi were able to save most of the Togruta, despite the Keeper's attempt to kill them all in a final act of spite, and Rex impaled the Keeper with an [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaff]]. The experience gave Obi-Wan strong anti-slavery feelings, allowing him to better sympathize with Anakin's past.

[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] asked that the Processing Hub be kept intact for future use by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Realizing that this structure could really be used for only one thing, Anakin and Obi-Wan agreed to blow up the slaver fortress regardless of the Chancellor's wishes.
